relationships.evidence_quote: chronic IMD treatment attenuated short-term facilitation (STF) of NMJ by more than 20%

relationships.subject: imidacloprid
relationships.evidence_quote: the gene expression of Arr2, which mediates both desensitization and resensitization processes of the G-protein coupled receptor (GPCR) [36], was significantly decreased

relationships.subject: osthole
relationships.evidence_quote: the treatment of the antioxidant osthole rescued the chronic IMD-induced phenotypes

key_findings: Chronic environmental-dose imidacloprid is neither agonist nor antagonist of Drosophila glutamate receptors but dampens NMJ short-term facilitation and desensitizes mechanosensory, nociceptive and photic responses.
The antioxidant osthole rescues these phenotypes, implicating oxidative stress.
